main_claim: Topuria explains his ties to his Alicante neighbourhood, where he grew up, trained at the Climent gym and worked odd jobs, saying everything he has in life is there.
note: The body and headline are his roots in Alicante (gym, quitting school, security-guard and cashier jobs, 'no cambio Alicante', 'soy una persona bastante normal'), so personal_life from himself. The lead's line that his physical trainer says he could be ready by year end is a his_team status_update an editor could take as the fact; it only says when he will be ready, so health stays no.

main_claim: Dana White says Topuria is ready to fight again, although the UFC has nothing scheduled for him yet.
note: White: 'No lo tenemos en la agenda por ahora, pero Topuria está listo para pelear' is the promotion stating he is ready with nothing booked, so status_update; Gaethje and Pimblett are only options ('ambas me parecen bien'), so next fight no. 'Parece que el Matador está recuperado' is the writer's inference, so health no, though an editor could read White's 'ready' as a recovery update. His own statement is described, not quoted.

main_claim: The León sports forum announces Carolina Marín, Carlos Moyá and Topuria's performance director Aldo Martínez as its first speakers.
note: Topuria appears only as the fighter Martínez works for ('director de rendimiento deportivo de Ilia Topuria'); nothing in the article is about him. The main content is a forum's speaker announcement with nobody quoted, so source no_one (the forum organisers would fit none_of_these) and act none_of_these because nobody does anything regarding him.

main_claim: Topuria's physical trainer Doctor Aldo explains on social media what the Brock string eye-training exercise is.
note: Topuria is named only to identify the trainer; the text explains the exercise ('coger una cuerda con bolas de colores') and never says Topuria does it, so act none_of_these: the trainer speaks about a method, not about him.

main_claim: After beating Soriano at UFC Fight Night 287, Donchenko says he wants Daniel Rodriguez next, ideally at the year-end event or a five-round Apex main event.
note: A backstage interview after the fight: 'Please, let me fight just with him' is his wish, so no_fact and next fight no. The win over Soriano is retold in detail (scorecards, judge Eric Colon's round), but a post-fight interview is not an account of the fight, so result no; an editor could take the result as the fact.

main_claim: Topuria's manager Malki Kawa answers Ali Abdelaziz's prediction that Usman Nurmagomedov would finish Topuria by saying Topuria would annihilate his whole roster and remains number one.
note: Kawa replies on his behalf to Abdelaziz's callout ('Cállate la boca. Ilia Topuria aniquilará al 100% de tu roster', 'sigue siendo el número 1'), which is answers_for_him; the Usman fight 'sigue siendo solo una posibilidad, sin fecha ni acuerdo', so no_fact. The Usman section gives him real content too, so one_of_several is arguable; his recovery and 2027 return are a closing recap.

main_claim: Merab Dvalishvili says Topuria is well, positive and enjoying life during his recovery and will return to reclaim his belt.
note: The article frames Merab's words as information 'sobre su recuperación y estado de salud' from his circle: 'Está bien. Es muy positivo. Está disfrutando de la vida', a named friend stating how he is, so health at reported; but the headline quote is a prediction and 'está bien' is thin, so status_update or no_fact with assesses_him are reasonable. Merab is a teammate and friend, not booked against him. Topuria's post-fight message is quoted at length under 'Las palabras de Topuria', so he_speaks yes although it is from an earlier occasion; Gaethje's 'no habrá revancha' answers a wish, so next fight no.

main_claim: Makhachev says Topuria is young and a good fighter who can be champion again if he regains his focus after the Gaethje loss.
note: 'Si se centra, puede ser campeón otra vez' and the view that he underestimated Gaethje are an assessment of his level and mindset; the fight between them never happened, so Makhachev is other_fighter_side. 'Debe recuperar la concentración' could be read as steers_him. The loss and eye injuries are background.

main_claim: Matt Brown says the UFC risks ruining Topuria's life by giving him an immediate Gaethje rematch and should give him a return fight against someone like Moicano.
note: Brown, a former fighter, sincerely says 'he needs a proper return fight' against Moicano, so steers_him and no_fact. The premise that Jon Anik says 'internal conversations are ongoing' about a rematch is a sourced rumour an editor could take as next_fight at rumour; I read it as the setup for Brown's opinion. Broken orbitals and nose are recap.

main_claim: Islam Makhachev says he does not consider Amosov a dangerous opponent for him, having seen his wrestling stopped in a fight.
note: The article is Makhachev's answer about Amosov ('Я взагалі не вважаю для себе його небезпечним'), an assessment of his level; no fight between them is booked, so other_fighter_side. Makhachev pivots to Ian Garry and the closing lines recap Amosov's May win, so one_of_several is arguable.

main_claim: Donchenko beat Punahele Soriano at UFC Fight Night 287 in Paris.
note: A short fight report: 'здобув перемогу над Пунахьєлем Соріано' with nobody quoted; future title fights are the writer's speculation.

main_claim: Topuria returns to social media for the first time since the Gaethje loss with a video letter to his son Hugo about what the defeat taught them both.
note: The post is a message to his son ('Hugo, I've been thinking about you'), which the guide labels personal_life; an editor could call it a reflection with no_fact. 'MMA Fighting reports that Topuria suffered extensive facial injuries but did not require surgery' is a one-line recalled report beside the video, so health no; 'no timetable' and a rematch 'on the table' are closing speculation.

main_claim: Donchenko and Soriano held their face-off before their UFC Fight Night 287 fight in Paris.
note: 'провели битву поглядів' before the 5 September fight is the routine of fight week; the booking itself is the premise, so next fight no. Soriano gets only a name and record while the body recaps Donchenko's year, so main_subject rather than one_of_several, though a face-off piece could be read as covering both.

main_claim: Paul Hughes says Topuria is the only UFC fighter with a chance against Usman Nurmagomedov should Usman sign with the promotion.
note: 'La única persona en la UFC que tiene una oportunidad contra Usman es Topuria' assesses his chances, opinion only; Hughes fought Usman, not Topuria, so other_fighter_side. Half the article is Usman's free agency and Khabib's negotiation timeline, so attention is shared, though the headline makes Topuria main_subject for some editors.

main_claim: Donchenko recalls joining the territorial defence with his brother on the second day of Russia's full-scale invasion, being sent home, fundraising for the army and leaving for Thailand six months later.
note: An interview about his life during the war ('пішов із братом Олегом на другий день', the Instagram fundraiser, his mother's calls), so personal_life from himself. The closing lines that he fights Soriano in Paris on 5 September and his TUF win are background, so next fight no.
